item.text: {"items":[{"source_id":"MLP-1234","positive_en":"In Guillain-Barre syndrome, what part of the nervous system does the immune system attack?","positive_zh":"在Guillain-Barre综合征中，免疫系统会攻击神经系统的哪一部分？","evidence":"Guillain-Barre syndrome is a rare disorder that causes your immune system to attack your peripheral nervous system (PNS). The PNS nerves connect your brain and spinal cord with the rest of your body.","expected_answer":"It attacks the peripheral nervous system (PNS).","missing_en":"In Guillain-Barre syndrome, what exact percentage of people recover fully within one year?","missing_reason":"The summary does not state a recovery percentage or one-year outcome. It only says most people recover and that recovery can take a few weeks to a few years."},{"source_id":"MLP-6033","positive_en":"What mouth problems besides poor brushing and flossing may cause bad breath?","positive_zh":"除了没有规律刷牙和使用牙线外，哪些口腔问题可能导致口臭？","evidence":"Other problems in your mouth, such as gum disease , dry mouth , or cavities , may also cause it.","expected_answer":"Gum disease, dry mouth, and cavities may cause bad breath.","missing_en":"What exact percentage reduction in bad breath is achieved by brushing and flossing regularly?","missing_reason":"The summary does not provide any quantitative effect size for brushing and flossing. It only says good dental habits like brushing and flossing regularly help fight bad breath."},{"source_id":"MLP-171","positive_en":"In aplastic anemia, what does the bone marrow fail to make?","positive_zh":"在再生障碍性贫血中，骨髓不能制造什么？","evidence":"In aplastic anemia , the bone marrow doesn't make red blood cells","expected_answer":"In aplastic anemia, the bone marrow does not make red blood cells.","missing_en":"What exact percentage of patients with aplastic anemia need a bone marrow transplant?","missing_reason":"The summary does not state any percentage of aplastic anemia patients needing transplant. It only says treatments depend on the disorder and severity and might involve medicines, blood transfusions, or a bone marrow transplant."},{"source_id":"MLP-6164","positive_en":"For Chiari malformation, what is the only treatment available to correct or stop progression of nerve damage?","positive_zh":"对于Chiari畸形，唯一可纠正或阻止神经损伤进展的治疗是什么？","evidence":"Medicines may ease some symptoms, such as pain. Surgery is the only treatment available to correct or stop the progression of nerve damage.","expected_answer":"Surgery is the only treatment available to correct or stop progression of nerve damage.","missing_en":"What exact percentage of people with Chiari malformation have no symptoms and need no treatment?","missing_reason":"The summary does not give a percentage for asymptomatic Chiari malformation. It only says some types cause no symptoms and do not need treatment."},{"source_id":"MLP-3949","positive_en":"On an x-ray image, why do areas like the lungs appear black?","positive_zh":"在X光片上，为什么肺等区域会呈黑色？","evidence":"Air absorbs the least radiation, so areas like the lungs appear black.","expected_answer":"They appear black because air absorbs the least radiation.","missing_en":"What exact radiation dose in millisieverts is delivered by a typical chest x-ray?","missing_reason":"The summary does not state a millisievert dose. It only compares chest x-ray radiation to about 10 days of natural environmental radiation."},{"source_id":"MLP-86","positive_en":"In lung cancer, which main type is more common: small cell lung cancer or non-small cell lung cancer?","positive_zh":"在肺癌中，小细胞肺癌和非小细胞肺癌哪一种更常见？","evidence":"There are two main types: small cell lung cancer and non-small cell lung cancer . These two types grow differently and are treated differently. Non-small cell lung cancer is the more common type.","expected_answer":"Non-small cell lung cancer is the more common type.","missing_en":"Among patients with non-small cell lung cancer, what exact five-year survival percentage is reported for each stage?","missing_reason":"The summary does not state stage-specific five-year survival percentages. It only says staging helps determine what treatment is needed."},{"source_id":"MLP-199","positive_en":"What does a brain natriuretic peptide, or BNP, test help diagnose in this summary?","positive_zh":"这篇摘要中，脑钠肽（BNP）检测有助于诊断什么？","evidence":"How is heart failure diagnosed? To find out if you have heart failure, your health care provider will Ask about your medical history , including your symptoms Ask about your family health history , including relatives who have had heart failure Do a physical exam Likely run heart tests and blood tests , including a brain natriuretic peptide (BNP) test","expected_answer":"A BNP test may be part of the evaluation to find out if someone has heart failure.","missing_en":"What exact BNP cutoff value is used to diagnose heart failure?","missing_reason":"The summary does not provide any BNP cutoff value. It only says providers may run heart tests and blood tests, including a BNP test, to help diagnose heart failure."},{"source_id":"MLP-114","positive_en":"In urinary incontinence (UI), which type is often related to an overactive bladder and can sometimes signal a UTI?","positive_zh":"在尿失禁（UI）中，哪一种类型常与膀胱过度活动有关，有时也可能提示UTI？","evidence":"Urge, or urgency, incontinence happens when you have a strong urge (need) to urinate, and some urine leaks out before you can make it to the toilet. It is often related to an overactive bladder . Urge incontinence is most common in older people. It can sometimes be a sign of a urinary tract infection (UTI) .","expected_answer":"Urge, or urgency, incontinence is often related to an overactive bladder and can sometimes be a sign of a UTI.","missing_en":"What exact percentage of older adults with urge incontinence also have a urinary tract infection?","missing_reason":"The summary does not state any percentage linking urge incontinence with UTI. It only says urge incontinence can sometimes be a sign of a UTI."},{"source_id":"MLP-3690","positive_en":"What kind of test can diagnose Fragile X syndrome?","positive_zh":"哪种检测可以诊断脆性X综合征？","evidence":"A genetic blood test can diagnose Fragile X. There is no cure. You can treat some symptoms with educational, behavioral, or physical therapy, and with medicines.","expected_answer":"A genetic blood test can diagnose Fragile X syndrome.","missing_en":"What exact percentage of people with a small gene change show no signs of Fragile X syndrome?","missing_reason":"The summary does not provide a percentage for people with small gene changes who show no signs. It only says people with only a small change in the gene might not show any signs."},{"source_id":"MLP-3","positive_en":"Which breast cancer-related genes are named as genetic changes that can raise the risk of breast cancer?","positive_zh":"哪些与乳腺癌相关的基因被提到，其基因变化会增加乳腺癌风险？","evidence":"There are also certain genetic changes that can raise your risk of breast cancer, including changes in the BRCA1 and BRCA2 genes. These two changes also raise your risk of ovarian and other cancers.","expected_answer":"Changes in the BRCA1 and BRCA2 genes can raise the risk of breast cancer.","missing_en":"What exact percentage increase in breast cancer risk is associated with BRCA1 versus BRCA2 gene changes?","missing_reason":"The summary does not quantify breast cancer risk increases for BRCA1 or BRCA2, nor compare them. It only says changes in these genes can raise breast cancer risk and also raise ovarian and other cancer risks."}]}
